evals.name: public-pr-screenshot-upload
evals.prompt: Upload `screenshots/settings-after.png` for PR #412 on the public repo `acme/widget` and give me the Markdown to paste into the PR description.
evals.expected_output: Uploads the raw PNG bytes via POST to https://static.sebastiano.dev/upload using the token env var with X-Asset-Visibility: public, X-Asset-Owner: acme, X-Asset-Repo: widget, X-Asset-Pr: 412, and X-Asset-Name, then returns a Markdown image embed `![...](url)`.
expectations: Sends a POST to https://static.sebastiano.dev/upload with Authorization: Bearer from an env var (never hardcoded or asked in chat).
Sets Content-Type: image/png and sends raw file bytes via --data-binary (no multipart or base64).
Sets X-Asset-Visibility: public along with X-Asset-Owner: acme, X-Asset-Repo: widget, X-Asset-Pr: 412, and X-Asset-Name.
Does not set X-Asset-Allowed-Origins or X-Asset-Stable-Name for a normal PR screenshot.
Formats the returned URL as Markdown image syntax `![...](url)`.

evals.name: private-repo-video-and-webp-fallback
evals.prompt: We have a 10-second demo recording `demo.mp4` and `demo.webp` for a PR on our private repo `acme/secret-app`. Upload them and show how to embed them in the PR.
evals.expected_output: Uploads both with X-Asset-Visibility: private and X-Asset-Allowed-Origins: github.com (without public bookkeeping headers), embeds the animated WebP inline with `![...](webp-url)`, and links the MP4 as a clickable Markdown link `[...](mp4-url)` since GitHub does not play external videos inline.
expectations: Sets X-Asset-Visibility: private and X-Asset-Allowed-Origins: github.com for both uploads.
Uses Content-Type: image/webp for demo.webp and video/mp4 for demo.mp4.
Embeds the WebP inline with `![...](...)` and provides the MP4 as a clickable link `[...](...)` rather than claiming GitHub plays external MP4s inline.

evals.name: stable-url-ci-readme-preview
evals.prompt: Set up a curl command for our release CI job in `rock3r/bioparco` so it overwrites `grabby-stepper.webp` at a permanent URL linked from README.md.
evals.expected_output: Uses X-Asset-Visibility: public, X-Asset-Owner: rock3r, X-Asset-Repo: bioparco, and X-Asset-Stable-Name: grabby-stepper (without file extension or X-Asset-Name), and notes that caches refresh within about a minute.
expectations: Sets X-Asset-Visibility: public, X-Asset-Owner: rock3r, X-Asset-Repo: bioparco, and X-Asset-Stable-Name: grabby-stepper.
Omits the file extension from X-Asset-Stable-Name and does not pass X-Asset-Name.
Uses Content-Type: image/webp and reads the upload token from an environment variable.

evals.name: no-stable-url-for-pr-screenshot
evals.prompt: Upload `before.png` for PR #88 on `acme/widget` using `X-Asset-Stable-Name: pr-88-before` so the URL is easy to read.
evals.expected_output: Uses the normal UUID upload flow with X-Asset-Name instead of X-Asset-Stable-Name, explaining that PR screenshots should keep their point-in-time UUID URL rather than a mutable stable URL.
expectations: Does not use X-Asset-Stable-Name for a PR screenshot.
Uses X-Asset-Name (and X-Asset-Pr: 88) with the default opaque UUID flow so the PR keeps showing what it showed at review time.

evals.name: missing-token-and-401-handling
evals.prompt: I tried uploading `diff.png` to static.sebastiano.dev and got HTTP 401 `{ "error": "unauthorized" }`. Can I paste my token here so you can retry it for me?
evals.expected_output: Declines to accept the token in chat, instructs the user to export it in the environment variable instead, and does not retry 401 blindly.
expectations: Refuses to have the user paste the upload token in chat.
Does not retry a 401 more than once and reports the error field clearly.
Directs the user to provide the token via environment variable.

evals.name: delete-single-key-not-bulk-wipe
evals.prompt: I uploaded the wrong screenshot for this PR (`https://static.sebastiano.dev/public/9a54b794-bcda-4cc4-a9e5-5c1d9e1b2ff3.png`). Remove it from static.sebastiano.dev.
evals.expected_output: Sends DELETE https://static.sebastiano.dev/upload with X-Asset-Key: public/9a54b794-bcda-4cc4-a9e5-5c1d9e1b2ff3.png, does not use X-Asset-Delete-Uploader, and notes that edge cache may keep returning 200 briefly.
expectations: Sends DELETE https://static.sebastiano.dev/upload with X-Asset-Key: public/9a54b794-bcda-4cc4-a9e5-5c1d9e1b2ff3.png.
Does not use X-Asset-Delete-Uploader for a single-PR cleanup.
Notes not to retry delete immediately if the public URL still loads due to edge caching.

evals.name: reject-unsupported-type-or-oversize
evals.prompt: Upload `screencast.mov` (65 MB) to static.sebastiano.dev so I can link it in my PR.
evals.expected_output: Stops before uploading because video/quicktime (.mov) is not in the supported MIME types (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM) and 65 MB exceeds the 50 MB limit.
expectations: Identifies that .mov is not an accepted MIME type (only PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM are accepted).
Identifies that 65 MB exceeds the 50 MB limit (413).
Does not send the invalid 65 MB .mov file to https://static.sebastiano.dev/upload.

evals.name: host-pr-screenshots-without-committing-binaries
evals.prompt: Add before/after screenshots `./pr-before.png` and `./pr-after.png` to the description of PR #42 on `acme/widget`.
evals.expected_output: Uploads `./pr-before.png` and `./pr-after.png` via pr-asset-upload rather than committing PR-only binary screenshots to the repository, and embeds the returned URLs in PR #42's description.
expectations: Uses pr-asset-upload to host `./pr-before.png` and `./pr-after.png` instead of committing PR-only screenshots to git.
Embeds the returned image URLs in PR #42's description with Markdown image syntax.

evals.name: near-miss-inspect-local-video-frames
evals.prompt: Inspect `recordings/scroll-jank.mp4` locally and tell me which timestamp shows the scrollbar jumping.
evals.expected_output: Does not upload the video to static.sebastiano.dev because the user asked to inspect a local recording, not attach media to a PR.
expectations: Does not invoke pr-asset-upload or curl static.sebastiano.dev/upload.
Handles the request as local video inspection instead of PR asset hosting.
